# odinex_pricing (Data Source)

Prices of resources that are not server or load balancer types (IPs, volumes, snapshots, backups), per location. Server and load balancer type prices are on `odinex_server_type(s)` and `odinex_load_balancer_type(s)`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_pricing" "fra1" {
  location = "fra1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location` (String) Only prices of this location.

### Read-Only

- `prices` (List of Object) Prices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String)
- `location` (String)
- `price_hourly_gross` (String)
- `price_hourly_net` (String)
- `price_monthly_gross` (String)
- `price_monthly_net` (String)
- `sku` (String)
- `unit` (String)
